metadata.description: AI-augmented research workflow plugins for the African Research Group for Oncology. Built around REDCap as the system of record for multi-site oncology cohorts.

plugins.name: argo-core
plugins.description: The ARGO foundation, required by every other plugin: start-here (the front door — orients new users, runs first-time setup, routes to the right skill) plus shared REDCap API conventions, the common client, and reference docs.

plugins.name: argo-project-manager
plugins.description: For the ARGO project manager. See where every study stands and what requests are open (monitor-studies), and draft the document package for a new study (new-study-documents).

plugins.name: argo-database-manager
plugins.description: For the ARGO database manager. See what requests are outstanding across the core tracking REDCaps, then fulfil them: build a study's REDCap from a submitted request (build-study), add people and manage access (manage-redcaps), get data out as files (export-data), and match records across studies with safe fill-blanks-only write-back (link-data). Works with or without an access key.

plugins.name: argo-qa-specialist
plugins.description: For the ARGO QA specialist. Build the per-site worklists of missing data for your study's RAs, and audit what they send back.

plugins.name: argo-data-analyst
plugins.description: Analysis on a local REDCap export — no access key needed. Interview-driven analysis plan, saved well-commented scripts (Python/R/Stata), and organized, auditable outputs (run-analysis). For API export/import and cross-study linkage, see argo-database-manager.
